Use this tool when **self-respect, values, or personal integrity are the main priority**. DEAR organizes what you want to say; FAST helps you say it while protecting self-respect: **Fair, no unnecessary Apologies, Stick to values, Truthful**.

If your main priority is a concrete objective, use **[DEAR MAN](/tool-finder/dear-man/)**. If your main priority is strengthening the relationship, use **[DEAR GIVE](/tool-finder/dear-give/)**.

**No unnecessary Apologies** means avoiding apology for existing, having reasonable needs, holding appropriate boundaries, or having an opinion. It does not mean refusing to apologize when an apology is warranted.

Keep the script factual, respectful, and truthful. Self-respect does not require aggression; it means communicating in a way you can stand behind afterward.

User-entered data stays in your browser and is not uploaded by this tool. Save the Markdown (`.md`) file to resume later; export DOCX or print/save as PDF for a readable copy.
